use.flag: Enable the GTK4 / Libadwaita graphical interface

pkgmetadata.longdescription: t2-debug is a live Apple T2 (bridgeOS) debugger that interfaces over the Instruments dtservicehub via CDC-NCM USB link, featuring a live process top viewer and os_log stream viewer with both CLI (t2debug) and GTK4/Libadwaita GUI.
